national_rules.nationalAllocation: Remaining seats are allocated nationally by D’Hondt over the pooled remainders of lists above the threshold, then assigned to constituencies.
national_rules.districtAllocation: In each constituency lists first win as many seats as their votes contain the electoral coefficient.

description.en: A list needs at least 5% of national valid votes (Law 208/2015; higher thresholds for alliances; the alternative constituency criterion is not tested here). The six lists holding seats are exactly those above 5%.
description.zh-CN: 名单须获得全国有效票至少 5%（第 208/2015 号法律；联盟门槛更高；此处未检验替代的选区条件）。获得席位的六份名单恰为超过 5% 者。

minorityRepresentation.en: Organisations of national minorities that win no list seat receive one Chamber seat each if they obtain at least 5% of the average valid votes per deputy (Art. 56); in 2016 seventeen did, matching the organisations the Chamber lists for its 2016–2020 term.
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 未获名单席位的少数民族组织，若得票达到每名议员平均有效票的 5%，各获众议院一席（第 56 条）；2016 年有 17 个组织达到，与众议院 2016–2020 届所列组织一致。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 329 deputies: 312 list seats in 43 constituencies and 17 national-minority organisation seats.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 329 名众议员：43 个选区名单席位 312 席，少数民族组织 17 席。

notes.en: Votes are national sums of the AEP polling-station and postal files; seats come from the AEP mandate file. A simplified two-stage allocation reproduces the seats within one seat; the official file is used. Turnout is not published because the AEP count columns are undocumented. Independent candidates are aggregated without names.
notes.zh-CN: 得票为 AEP 投票站文件与邮寄投票文件的全国合计；席位来自 AEP 席位分配文件。简化的两阶段分配与官方席位相差一席以内；采用官方文件。由于 AEP 计数字段未有说明，不发布投票率。独立候选人合并列示，不存储姓名。

seat_check.allocation_model: simplified model differs by one seat (PARTIDUL SOCIAL DEMOCRAT / PARTIDUL ALIANȚA LIBERALILOR ȘI DEMOCRAȚILOR); mandate file used

interval_basis: election-specific: Law 208/2015 as applied in 2024 (section i cites its Art. 94); the institutional registry holds the statute read from the Chamber of Deputies site (partly verified)
system_family: list proportional representation in 43 constituencies (42 counties and Bucharest, plus abroad) with national pooling of remainders; national-minority organisation seats
allocation_method: constituency quota (electoral coefficient), then national D’Hondt over pooled remainders

national_rules.nationalAllocation: Remaining seats are allocated nationally by D’Hondt over the pooled remainders of lists above the threshold (section i.1), then assigned to constituencies (section j).
national_rules.districtAllocation: In each constituency lists first win as many seats as their votes contain the electoral coefficient (section i.2).

description.en: A list needs at least 5% of national valid votes (Law 208/2015; higher thresholds for alliances; the alternative constituency criterion is not tested here). The seven lists in sections i–k are exactly those above 5%.
description.zh-CN: 名单须获得全国有效票至少 5%（第 208/2015 号法律；联盟门槛更高；此处未检验替代的选区条件）。第 i–k 节所列七份名单恰为超过 5% 者。

minorityRepresentation.en: Organisations of national minorities that win no list seat receive one Chamber seat each if they obtain at least 5% of the average valid votes per deputy (Art. 56): the act prints an average of 25396 and a minimum of 1269 votes; nineteen organisations qualified (section m.5).
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 未获名单席位的少数民族组织，若得票达到每名议员平均有效票的 5%，各获众议院一席（第 56 条）：决议载明平均票数 25396、最低票数 1269；共 19 个组织达到（第 m.5 节）。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 331 deputies: 312 list seats in 43 constituencies and 19 national-minority organisation seats.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 331 名众议员：43 个选区名单席位 312 席，少数民族组织 19 席。

notes.en: Votes, counts and seats are from the Central Electoral Bureau's final act no. 3RF/BEC/SCD2024 of 2024-12-07, transcribed by eye from the scan. National D'Hondt over the remainders reproduces section j exactly. Turnout is derived (b ÷ a). Independent candidates are aggregated without names.
notes.zh-CN: 得票、计数与席位取自中央选举局 2024-12-07 第 3RF/BEC/SCD2024 号最终决议，依扫描件人工转录。对余票的全国 D’Hondt 分配完全复现第 j 节。投票率为推算值（b ÷ a）。独立候选人合并列示，不存储姓名。
